mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stock_counts WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_counts SET status = 'POSTED', posted_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_count_lines (count_id, product_id, counted_qty) VALUES (#{countId}, #{productId}, #{countedQty}) ON CONFLICT (count_id, product_id) DO UPDATE SET counted_qty = EXCLUDED.counted_qty
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_count_lines SET system_qty = #{systemQty} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stock_count_lines WHERE count_id = #{countId} ORDER BY product_id
